Applicant :- Ram Awatar

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Dileep Kumar(Senior Adv.),Rajrshi Gupta,Sunil Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record 2.

This bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in case crime No.711 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and section 3/4 D.P. Act, police station Sirsaganj, District Firozabad with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
The applicant is uncle-in-law (Chachiya Sasur) of deceased.
The marriage of deceased with nephew of applicant has taken place in the year 2022.
It was submitted that only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased have been levelled against all the accused persons, including applicant.

No specific role has been assigned to the Ram Awatar vs State Of U.P. on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70084799/
1 applicant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In postmortem report, except ligature mark, no other injury has been shown on body of deceased and cause of death has been shown asphyxia as a result of ante-mortem hanging.

It has been further submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 09.01.2024, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.

5. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
6. The bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Ram Awatar involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii. The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.

iii.
The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

8. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
9. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 12.4.2024 Neeraj/Anand  Ram Awatar vs State Of U.P. on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70084799/
